registration.task: wave 49-b (executed in wave 51) — quilt-jepa ROUND 2: the three design laws paid for by round-1's honest FAILs, re-registered as falsifiable claims on a hard world. Round-1 verdict (3/6) receipted: (a) surprise needs a hard world, (b) anomaly detection needs a concentration statistic not a global mean, (c) fault-injection needs impact-sensitive corruption. This registration v2 is a NEW file; v1 (registration.json) is untouched history.

registration.law: same JEPA law as round 1: loss = mean((predicted_latent - target_latent)^2) in latent space ONLY; target encoder EMA tau=0.999; clipped SGD; 16x16 cells, per-cell 4-dim latents; Perona-Malik mesh lambda=0.2. World upgraded: core/world2.js (hard world, above).
registration.measurement_lesson_receipted: round-1 P3 measured surprise at each registered anomaly tick BEFORE injecting the intruder into the observation, so the actual prediction-error spike landed on the NEXT transition (tick t+1) which was excluded from BOTH sides of the ratio. The 1.098 FAIL was scored as-registered and stands as honest history, but round 2 corrects the semantics: at an anomaly tick the intruder corrupts the NEW observation BEFORE the surprise is computed (the model is surprised by a transition it could not have predicted). Round-1's global-mean dilution lesson remains independently registered.

claims.text: Hard world, real learning: on world2 the mean latent-prediction loss over the first 10 training steps exceeds 0.05 (the world is NOT pre-solved: round-1's easy world entered at 0.0090), AND the mean loss over the last 10 steps is < 50% of the first-10 mean (learning had something to eat and ate it).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff lossFirst10 > 0.05 AND lossLast10/lossFirst10 < 0.5; else FAIL with both numbers

claims.text: EMA stationarity survives the hard diet: L2 drift of the target encoder from a snapshot at step 200 over 200 further steps is < 1% of its final L2 norm (tau=0.999 fixed-point law on world2).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff drift/norm < 0.01; else FAIL with the ratio

claims.text: Concentration statistic (design law b): define per-cell surprise at a tick as |zPred - zTgt| per cell; the CONCENTRATED surprise of a tick = mean of its top-4 cells (4 = intruder footprint). Mean concentrated surprise at the 3 registered anomaly ticks (intruder applied BEFORE scoring, per the receipted timing fix) exceeds 3x the mean concentrated surprise over 30 baseline ticks in the held-out window (baseline excludes anomaly ticks and their +1 recovery transients). The GLOBAL-mean ratio is also receipted as a contrast observation (round-1's dilution lesson predicts it stays low; it gates nothing).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff concentrated anomaly_mean / concentrated baseline_mean > 3.0; else FAIL with both ratios (concentrated and global)

claims.text: Determinism crown carries to round 2: two full executions of the round-2 core with the same seed produce byte-identical metrics (sha256 of canonical metrics JSON equal).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff the two metrics shas are equal; else FAIL with both hashes

claims.text: Mesh conservation law carries: under diffusion-only mesh steps (lambda=0.2) loaded from a world2 energy field, total energy conserved within 1e-6 relative and energy variance strictly non-increasing across 100 consecutive steps.
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff max relative total drift <= 1e-6 AND variance non-increasing; else FAIL with the first violating step

claims.text: Impact-sensitive zero self-repair (design law c): the probe set is a FIXED registered window of 30 (obsT, obsT1) world2 pairs captured from ticks 531-560 (with their live pre-corruption losses). Per-cell impact = mean per-cell latent loss over the probe set; the top-26 cells (26x16 = 416 weights = 10.2% of 4096) are corrupted by sign-flipping ALL their context-encoder weights (deterministic ranking, ties by lower cell index). Then: (i) JUMP — probe-set loss after corruption exceeds 1.5x the pre-corruption probe loss on the SAME fixed pairs (the corruption actually lands; round-1's random flip moved loss -2%); (ii) FROZEN-STATE INVARIANT — with NO further gradient steps, the parameter state is inert: the full weight-state sha256 after 50 further live world ticks (encode/predict/encodeTarget only, no training, no EMA) is identical to the state at corruption time, and the probe-set loss re-evaluated on the fixed pairs at that state equals the post-corruption probe loss within 1e-9 — nothing repairs without a gradient signal, and nothing mutates without one.
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff jump > 1.5 AND state_sha_unchanged AND |probe_loss_recheck - probe_loss_corrupted| <= 1e-9; else FAIL with the numbers
